## History

Peter Sloane is a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community who involved himself in local developments, including the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. He contributed to the effort by ordering the paint for the hall, though a mix-up with the paint numbers inadvertently resulted in the building being painted bright blue instead of green.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +64 more_
